input: Any commit that modifies /moves/bishop_c8.text must be signed by bishop_c8's own key and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys, and every commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num, so that off-plan moves by repeat offenders like bishop_c8 (greed and amnesia) and queen_d8 (greed) cannot be accepted without near-unanimous team agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
